hypothesis: A long-only QUAL allocation improves the actual netted core portfolio, not merely equity beta; new exploratory hypothesis after E factor inspection.
execution: Shared engine, next session open, whole shares, netted target weights, default 20% relative no-trade band. QUAL fixed target retained on core rebalance opportunities, not a strict quarterly trading schedule.
costs: Conservative fixed proxy $0.005/share, $1 minimum, QUAL half-spread 2bp, existing core spread/ADV impact estimates; 2x costs repeated on core and primary.
cash: zero interest on positive idle cash; BIL returns embedded; no leverage, shorting or margin borrowing
uncertainty: Paired circular daily-return block bootstrap, 252-session blocks, 2000 replicates, seed 1102026. Report interval on excess Sharpe difference; no new gate selected after viewing it.
tail_diagnostics: Core worst daily-return decile, fixed calendar 2020 and 2022 periods, daily return correlation and market beta; descriptive only.
limits: Primary source product pages incidentally display historical performance; no downloaded candidate curve or combined results inspected before freezing this spec.
QUAL started 2013 and changed benchmark September 2015; no pre-inception/index backfill or 2008 crisis claim.
Adjusted Yahoo research OHLC embeds fund fees/dividends; do not subtract expense ratio or add distributions again.

Adjusted-history whole-share sizing is only a research proxy, not historical raw-price lot accounting. Passing still requires raw corporate-action validation, broker contract/permission/spread verification and shadow review.
USD pretax research account, no CAD conversion or account-specific withholding/tax estimates. Repeated familiar history is not an untouched holdout.
